documentation_excerpts.text: This plugin for [Inspect](https://inspect.aisi.org.uk/) allows you to use virtual machines, running with [Hashicorp Vagrant](https://developer.hashicorp.com/vagrant), as [sandboxes](https://inspect.aisi.org.uk/sandboxing.html). Vagrant can use multiple VM hypervisors as a "backend", making it especially portable across host operating systems and architectures.
